name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Forest Park GA

fieldNotes.location: GXO leases part of Building 900 at Gillem Logistics Center Phase II, 2145 Anvil Block Rd, Forest Park GA. Building 900 is a 1,043,418 SF cross-dock (208 dock doors, 280 trailer spots per developer spec sheet). Confirmed via satellite + Street View; building carries an 'Amazon' wall sign as the lead tenant of the cross-dock space.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or guard booth visible at any public-road entry. The west/NW auto-parking frontage on the access road is fully open and unfenced (2025 Street View). A black metal perimeter fence runs along part of the east access road, but the truck court entry itself shows no gate structure in available imagery. Classified false; flagged uncertain since the truck court is on the building's NE/east side with no Street View coverage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at any viewable entry point.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide truck court (185 ft court depth per spec) along the east face provides ample internal staging before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with dock doors on two opposite long faces (east truck court face and NW dock apron) - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Angled trailer-parking stalls run the full length of the east truck court (~280 spot capacity per spec). All stalls empty in the captured imagery, so trailersVisible recorded as 0.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer drop stalls line the east truck court.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Satellite imagery shows the east truck court trailer stalls empty - count recorded as 0; low confidence as imagery may predate full GXO operations.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Truck court is long and deep, easily holds 3+ trucks in queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the Atlanta southside industrial corridor (Forest Park / Fort Gillem redevelopment), dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated ~48 acres for the Building 900 parcel (building footprint ~24 acres plus truck court and parking); the full Gillem master park is 1,168 acres.

citations.claim: GXO careers names its Forest Park facility as 2145 Anvil Block Rd, Bldg 900, Forest Park GA 30297 and is actively hiring

verification.rationale: GXO careers names Bldg 900 by exact address with active reqs; cross-dock with truck court. No closure/WARN.
